subject.title: fix(mattermost): keep finalized preview when a trailing tool-error warning falls back

question: Should Mattermost consume the draft after a preview becomes the durable final reply, or intentionally keep that finalized draft attached while selectively suppressing destructive cleanup?
rationale: Both open PRs repair the reported deletion, but they establish different permanent lifecycle contracts; selecting whether finalization consumes draft ownership requires the feature-history owner's intent because it affects later payload delivery beyond the demonstrated warning case.

options.title: Consume Finalized Draft
options.body: Omit the draft after successful preview finalization so every later payload uses normal durable delivery and cannot edit or clear the finalized answer.

options.title: Keep Clear-Only Guard
options.body: Retain this approach only if maintainers intentionally permit reuse of a finalized draft and add coverage proving later payload classes cannot overwrite or otherwise mutate the durable answer.

recommendation.title: Consume Finalized Draft
recommendation.body: Omit the draft after successful preview finalization so every later payload uses normal durable delivery and cannot edit or clear the finalized answer.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced and refined the Mattermost draft-preview lifecycle and are best positioned to confirm its intended terminal ownership contract.
